needs_review: Shape-proof 2026-09-11 is overall FAIL: 4 AMBIGUOUS, 2 FAIL, 0 AUTH_WALL. Cloudflare answers an invalid Authorization header with HTTP 400 (code 6003 / 6111), not 401, so no probe can reach AUTH_WALL or SHAPE_PROVEN with a dummy credential. The 400 bodies are structured Cloudflare API errors at every path, which is evidence of host, TLS, base_url and route, but the harness cannot class it as proof.

get_zone and list_dns_records class FAIL on a 404 with code 7003 ('Could not route to ..., perhaps your object identifier is invalid?'). The harness substitutes the literal string 'quoxprobe' for zone_id, and Cloudflare requires a 32-hex object identifier. The control probe returns a DIFFERENT 404 (code 10404, 'No route for that URI'), so the two are distinguishable, but only a real zone ID can settle it. Paths are verbatim from https://developers.cloudflare.com/api/ and were NOT altered to chase a class.
rateLimit is not declared (schema warning). Cloudflare's documented global limit is 1200 requests per five minutes per user; a band was not invented here.
